note: The user answers the needs-human blocker in a later session: a re-lock Decision quoting them, then a full Goal entry that supersedes the first, then the stage that raised the blocker runs again.

cites.text: A re-lock needs the user: in one Bash command, append a `## Decision` entry of Type re-lock quoting their words, then a new `## Goal — Locked` entry with the full template and a `Supersedes: <timestamp of the prior Goal entry>` line.
record the answer as a re-lock (Stage 0 step 4), and re-spawn the stage that raised it.
